sloka: ततः सर्वा दिशो राजा चोदयित्वा यथा तथम् ।कपि सेना पतीन् वीरो मुमोद सुखितः सुखम् ॥४-४५-८॥
transliteration: tataḥ sarvā diśo rājā codayitvā yathā tatham ।kapi senā patīn vīro mumoda sukhitaḥ sukham ॥4-45-8॥

translations.english: Sugriva, chief of the army of monkeys, having sent the leaders to all quarters felt relieved and rejoiced.
